description_en:
Submits the staging (unstable) code of an Edge Routine and generates a production version.
Prerequisite: Before calling this API operation, call GetRoutineStagingCodeUploadInfo to obtain OSS upload credentials. Upload the code file through OSS POST. After the upload callback succeeds, call this API operation to submit the code
description_zh:
提交边缘函数Routine的测试版本（unstable）代码，生成正式版本。
前置工作流说明：调用本 API 前必须先调用 GetRoutineStagingCodeUploadInfo 获取 OSS 上传凭证，通过 OSS POST 上传代码文件，上传回调成功后再调用本 API 提交
name: CommitRoutineStagingCode

parameters.help_en: The name of the Edge Routine
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The description of the code version
parameters.name: code_description

parameters.help_en: The deployment environment. The environment variable configuration of the specified environment is used. If you do not specify this parameter, environment variables are not used
parameters.help_zh: 指定部署环境（将使用对应环境的环境变量配置），若不指定，则不使用环境变量
parameters.name: deploy_env

CodeVersion.description_en: The newly generated code version number
